g.text: READ-ONLY AVAILABILITY, NOT NEW MODEL RESULTS

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23.586889px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172e47

g.text: More supported sources do not create independent validation.

text.style: font-size: 17.28px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506478

g.text: The lower-leg readout improves coverage without requiring reliable arm observations for every

g.text: Describe the next evaluation as exploratory reuse of the available cohort.
